title: Candido Portinari's birth chart
metaDescription: Candido Portinari's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 6.7° Capricorn. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Across the nine placements whose signs are settled, cardinal leads with three. Cardinal weight is read as initiative: the instinct to be the reason something began.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 6.7° Capricorn: the first decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Saturn. An earth sign, read here in its first face.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 25.9° Capricorn; Venus stands at 22.4° Scorpio; Mars stands at 13.5° Aquarius. The tradition reads a mind that trusts the measured and the checked from Mercury, taste tuned to mood and undertow from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins Jupiter and Pluto — a square holding at 2.0°. A square is friction that produces motion — the aspect the tradition credits with building capability precisely by refusing to be comfortable. Behind it, the Sun opposition Neptune at 2.3°, and Mercury sextile Venus at 3.5° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, three sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Scorpio at 22.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Jupiter in Pisces at 17.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Saturn in Aquarius at 7.7° is in domicile. The old table grades terrain, not talent — a placement in fall works uphill, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Balance, counted honestly across the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day: elements water 3, air 3, earth 2, fire 1; modalities cardinal 3, fixed 3, mutable 3. Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Aries into Taurus during that day at the birthplace, travelling 13.1° between one midnight and the next. The hour would decide it; no hour was recorded. The reading keeps the question open rather than flipping a coin dressed as astrology.
